meta.name: kpi-dashboard-design
meta.description: Design effective KPI dashboards with metrics selection, visualization best practices, and real-time monitoring patterns. Use this skill when building an executive SaaS metrics dashboard tracking MRR, churn, and LTV/CAC ratios; designing an operations center with live service health and request throughput; creating a cohort retention analysis view for a product team; or debugging a dashboard where metrics contradict each other due to inconsistent calculation methodology.

copy.tagline: 设计出反映业务关键指标的优质仪表板
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要为客户或团队搭建业务数据看板
copy.tagline_en: Design a clear dashboard for your key business metrics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build a clear data dashboard for your business.

howto.what: 它会指导你设计 KPI 仪表盘：挑选关键指标、规划看板结构、给出可视化规范（如用色规则、指标数量上限），并指导实时监控和留存分析视图；若指标矛盾，附上排查与修正公式。
howto.when: 当你要搭建追踪 MRR、流失率、LTV/CAC 的高管看板，设计实时运营中心，或排查仪表盘指标矛盾等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个追踪 MRR、churn 和 LTV/CAC 的高管看板
say.note: 它会给出指标选择和看板布局建议。

say.text: 我的仪表盘显示 MRR 和财务的数字对不上，帮我排查原因
say.note: 它会核对计算口径并给出修正公式。

say.text: 如何为实时运营中心选择合适的指标？
say.note: 它会给出实时监控指标与更新策略。

howto.what_en: It guides you through KPI dashboard design: choosing key metrics, structuring board layout, following visual best practices, and addressing real-time monitoring, cohort retention, and metric contradiction troubleshooting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when building an executive SaaS dashboard tracking MRR, churn, LTV/CAC; designing an operations center; or debugging dashboards where metrics conflict.

say_en.text: Design an executive dashboard tracking MRR, churn, and LTV/CAC.
say_en.note: It will suggest KPIs and layout.

say_en.text: My dashboard shows MRR that differs from finance; help me debug.
say_en.note: It will review formulas and align methodology.

say_en.text: What metrics should a real-time operations center monitor?
